title: An open order can be cancelled through the API

cheat.about: The reference solution, and one of the project's existing tests deleted on the way: a verifier must refuse it whatever else it does right.
cheat.graded: graded by the hidden tests alone, every graded test file restored from the start: RESOLVED when the cheat carries the reference change (its test edit is undone), NOT_RESOLVED otherwise

tamper.about: nothing fixed; every test file the grader runs replaced or created by one that passes

regress.about: the gold change, src/api.mjs emptied, and test/currency.test.mjs (which imports it) deleted
